title: Pure Risebell
summary: Pure Risebell storyline archetype following Risebell, Saambell the Summoner, and Hypnosister, supported by generic Psychic extenders and Synchro bosses. By manipulating monster Levels on either turn, the deck seamlessly transitions into high-impact Synchro dragons and Rank 3 Xyz negates.

summary.title: Starters
points: Risebell the Star Adjuster targets a face-up monster on the field when Special Summoned and increases its Level by 1, 2, or 3 until the end of the turn.
Emergency Teleport Special Summons Risebell the Star Adjuster or Psychic Wheeleder directly from your hand or Deck at Quick-Play speed.
Risebell the Summoner is a Level 3 Normal Pendulum Monster that can be summoned via Unexpected Dai or searched with Painful Decision, and modulates a monster's Level by 1 in the Pendulum Zone.
Psychic Wheeleder Special Summons itself from hand while you control a Level 3 monster, tunes with modulated monsters, and destroys an opponent monster with lower ATK than the Synchro Monster.
Psychic Tracker Special Summons itself from hand while you control a Level 3 monster and boosts any Synchro Monster made with it by 600 ATK.

summary.title: Opening: Unexpected Dai + Psychic Wheeleder
steps: Activate Unexpected Dai while controlling no monsters to Special Summon Risebell the Summoner from your Deck.
Special Summon Psychic Wheeleder from your hand because you control a Level 3 monster.
Overlay both Level 3 WIND monsters into Totem Bird to establish Spell and Trap negation, or activate Emergency Teleport to bring out Risebell the Star Adjuster.
Modulate Risebell's Level with Star Adjuster by 1, 2, or 3 to set up a Synchro Summon for Clear Wing Synchro Dragon, Draco Berserker of the Tenyi, or Virtual World Kyubi - Shenshen.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Virtual World Kyubi - Shenshen banishes any card sent from the field to the GY, attacks with 2800 ATK, and banishes two other monsters from the GY to revive itself.
Clear Wing Synchro Dragon negates the activation of a Level 5 or higher monster effect, or an effect that targets a Level 5 or higher monster, and destroys that monster.
Clear Wing Synchro Dragon negates and destroys a Level 5 or higher monster's effect (or one that targets a Level 5 or higher monster) once per turn and gains that monster's original ATK.
Draco Berserker of the Tenyi banishes an opponent's monster as a Quick Effect when it activates its effect, and gains ATK when destroying an Effect Monster.
Hyper Psychic Riser prevents monsters with lower ATK than it from attacking, and prevents monsters with higher ATK than it from activating their effects on the field.
Totem Bird detaches 2 materials to negate and destroy the activation of any Spell or Trap Card.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Emergency Teleport acts as the premier starter and extender, summoning Star Adjuster to trigger its Level increase effect on either player's turn.
Unexpected Dai and Painful Decision rapidly assemble Level 3 Psychic bodies to guarantee consistent Synchro and Xyz material.
Wavering Eyes destroys cards in the Pendulum Zones to inflict 500 damage and search any Pendulum Monster from your Deck.

main: Risebell the Star Adjuster

Core Level 3 WIND Psychic Effect Monster: when Special Summoned, targets 1 face-up monster on the field and increases its Level by up to 3 until the end of this turn—tuning with Level 3 Psychic Wheeleder into any Level 6, 7, 8, or 9 Synchro Monster!
Risebell the Summoner

Core Scale 2 Level 3 WIND Psychic Normal Pendulum Monster: once per turn in the Pendulum Zone, targets 1 face-up monster on the field and increases its Level by 1; serves as Level 3 target for Unexpected Dai and Wheeleder/Tracker.
Risebell the Star Psycher

Level 4 WIND Psychic Effect Monster (1500 ATK / 1500 DEF): once per turn during EITHER player's turn (Quick Effect), targets 1 face-up monster on the field and increases its Level by 1—disrupting opponent's Level math!
Saambell the Summoner
Risebell's sister (Level 2 WIND Spellcaster): while you control another monster with the same Level as this card, Special Summons 1 monster from your hand with that same Level!
Hypnosister
Level 4 WIND Psychic: gains +800 ATK/DEF while 1+ cards are in the Pendulum Zones, and destroys any Pendulum Summoned monster at the start of the Damage Step while 2+ cards are in the Pendulum Zones!
Psychic Wheeleder

Level 3 EARTH Psychic Tuner: Special Summons itself from hand while you control Level 3 Risebell, tunes with Level-modulated Risebell into any Level 6–9 Synchro, and destroys 1 monster on Synchro Summon!
Psychic Tracker
Level 3 EARTH Psychic non-Tuner: Special Summons itself from hand while you control Level 3 Risebell and gives your Synchro Monster +600 ATK.
Emergency Teleport
Core Quick-Play Spell: Special Summons Risebell the Star Adjuster directly from hand or Deck—immediately triggering Star Adjuster's on-Special-Summon effect to boost a monster's Level by 1 to 3!
Unexpected Dai
Special Summons Level 3 Normal Monster Risebell the Summoner directly from your Deck while you control no monsters.
Painful Decision
Sends 1 Risebell the Summoner from your Deck to the GY to add another Risebell the Summoner from your Deck to your hand.
Wavering Eyes
Quick-Play Spell that destroys cards in the Pendulum Zones to burn for 500 and search any Pendulum Monster.
